description: This header file defines classes and structures for managing an IPC ring buffer used in display rendering within the 'cuttlefish' namespace. It includes definitions for the ring buffer header, the ring buffer itself, and a manager class to handle multiple buffers, with functions for creating, accessing, and manipulating display frames.

classes.name: DisplayRingBufferHeader
classes.description: Structure holding metadata about the display ring buffer, including dimensions, bits per pixel, and the last valid frame index.

classes.name: DisplayRingBuffer
classes.description: Class representing a ring buffer for display frames, with methods for creation, access, and frame management.

classes.name: DisplayRingBufferManager
classes.description: Class managing multiple display ring buffers, providing methods to create buffers and read/write frames.

methods.name: DisplayRingBufferHeader::set
methods.description: Sets the display width, height, bits per pixel, and frame index in the header.

methods.name: DisplayRingBuffer::Create
methods.description: Creates a new display ring buffer with the specified name and size.

methods.name: DisplayRingBuffer::ShmemGet
methods.description: Retrieves an existing shared memory display ring buffer if it exists.

methods.name: DisplayRingBuffer::GetAddress
methods.description: Returns the memory address of the ring buffer.

methods.name: DisplayRingBuffer::WriteNextFrame
methods.description: Writes the next frame data into the ring buffer.

methods.name: DisplayRingBuffer::CurrentFrame
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the current frame in the buffer.

methods.name: DisplayRingBuffer::ComputeFrameAddressForIndex
methods.description: Computes the memory address for a specific frame index.

methods.name: DisplayRingBuffer::DisplayRingBuffer
methods.description: Private constructor initializing the ring buffer with given parameters.

methods.name: DisplayRingBufferManager::CreateLocalDisplayBuffer
methods.description: Creates a local display buffer for a specific VM and display.

methods.name: DisplayRingBufferManager::WriteFrame
methods.description: Writes a frame to a specified display buffer.

methods.name: DisplayRingBufferManager::ReadFrame
methods.description: Reads a frame from a specified display buffer.

methods.name: DisplayRingBufferManager::MakeLayerName
methods.description: Generates a layer name based on display and VM indices.
